description: This file defines a PHP class 'Store' for the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin module. The class manages the display and saving of store configuration settings within the admin interface, handling HTTP requests, loading language resources, managing breadcrumbs, rendering views, and processing form submissions.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing store settings in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the store configuration page, sets up breadcrumbs, retrieves configuration values, and loads the necessary view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to save store configuration settings, checks permissions, updates settings, and returns a JSON response.
